name: Hikkoshi
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional moving company: a reception-hours notice, a first day helping with the moving work, a price-plan guide, a free-estimate consultation notice, a new-staff training plan comparison, a story about noticing a repeat customer's change through good service, a lesson teaching a new part-timer the basics of carrying belongings, an explainer on why the company still uses an old hand-pushed cart, a storage-service application guide, a column on how more solo moves booked online changed the company's work, a spring moving-season reservation rule new standard, a column on the meaning of a craftsman's skill for judging how to load a truck, and a one-year neighborhood moving-company-association cooperation report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
